_comment: Shared UI metadata for both sister apps (Mac tool + Android printer_app). Keyed by code-set number. 'description' shows under the row title, 'button' overrides the default Print button text on single-section sets, 'sections' overrides the filename-derived label for numbered sections. 'sets_media'/'sets_print_mode' name a MEDIA_TRACKING_MODES/PRINT_MODES key that this set's own payload configures on the printer - sending it also updates the app's Media/Print mode selector to match, so auto-restore reasserts that mode instead of silently reverting it. 'isolation': 'off' exempts a set from the isolated tab's restore-sandwich (for sets that deliberately test persistent state or queue semantics); apps without an isolated tab ignore the key.

1.description: Prints 1 label: Aztec, Code 11, I 2-of-5, Code 39, Code 49, Planet barcodes.

2.description: Prints the same barcodes as 01, with the text wrapped in ^FB field blocks.

3.description: Prints 1 label: PDF417, EAN-8, UPC-E, Code 93, Codablock, Code 128 barcodes.

4.description: Prints 1 label: UPS MaxiCode, EAN-13, MicroPDF417, 2-of-5 variants, Codabar.

5.description: Prints 1 label with a single UPS MaxiCode barcode.

6.description: Prints 1 label: LOGMARS, MSI, Aztec, Plessey, QR, RSS barcodes.

7.description: Prints 1 label: UPC-EAN extension, TLC39, UPC-A, Data Matrix, POSTNET.

8.description: Prints font samples A-H; remaps caret/delimiter chars mid-label (restores them).

10.description: Prints shapes, reversed colors, rotated text. Leaves ^LR line-reverse ON (persistent).

11.description: Sec 1: downloads font/format files, prints using them. Sec 2: downloads graphics, prints stored format.

12.description: Sec 1: builds and saves a label image to printer memory. Sec 2: recalls, prints, deletes it; file list answers in log.

13.description: Cancel and pause tests. Sec 1 (~JA) should print NOTHING - that is the pass condition. Sec 2 (^PP) prints one label, pauses; use Resume for the second.

14.description: Diagnostic mode toggle (~JD/~JE are inside comments). Mostly a no-op label; doc says run it twice.

15.description: ~JG sensor calibration: feeds media while calibrating. No label, no cut - that's normal.

16.description: Sets ^JJ error handling and prints 1 line. Doc suggests interrupting the print to test recovery.

17.description: Dot density ^JMA vs ^JMB. JMB (sec 2) persists: everything after prints double-size until reset.

18.description: Queue clearing. Sec 1 uses ~JA (safe everywhere, verified). Secs 2-3 use ~JP: WARNING - ~JP hard-locks the DPP-450 in every form (power cycle only); works on the Zebra ZD421. That difference IS the comparison data.

19.description: Changes delimiter, saves (^JUS), factory-resets (^JUF), restores (^JUR). Deliberately persistent.

20.description: Renames the printer (^KN), prints config (~WC), renames back, prints config again.

21.description: ^LH label home offsets (0,0 vs 100,100). Persists until reset.

22.description: ^LS/^LT shift offsets: print at 0, then at 200. Offset persists until reset.

23.description: ^MD darkness: print at -30, then at +30. Darkness persists until reset.

24.description: Prints 1 label, then ^PH feeds an extra blank page.

25.description: ^PR print speed: 3 copies fast (sec 1), 3 copies slow (sec 2). Speed persists.

26.description: ^PW300: squeezes printing into a 300-dot width. Persists - the classic 'everything condensed' culprit.

27.description: Counter reset: print config (~WC, note counters), reset (~RO1, no output), print config again. NOTE: the DPP-450's config lists no counters, so the reset is unverifiable on that printer.

28.description: ~SD absolute darkness: print at 0, then at 30. Persists until reset.

29.description: ^SF serialization: prints 3 labels with an auto-incrementing field.

30.description: ^SN serial number: prints 3 labels with an incrementing number.

31.description: Prints a full shipping label. Its ^BY barcode defaults persist into later barcodes.

32.description: Prints the shipping label MIRRORED (^PMY). Mirror mode persists - auto-restore clears it.

33.description: Field block/format commands (^FC ^FH ^FM ^FP ^FT ^FV ^MC). Sec 3 is a huge PDF417. ^PR1 slow speed persists.

34.description: ^MNW: switches media tracking to web/gap sensing, then prints 1 line. Sending this also sets the app's Media selector to Gap/Notch so auto-restore doesn't immediately revert it. UNCONFIRMED on the DPP-450: the user manual describes gap-vs-mark sensor selection as also gated by a physical memory switch ('Use Gap Sensor', Function Setting mode) and DIP switch SW2 - the ZPL command alone may not fully switch sensor types on this hardware the way it does on a Zebra. Pending on-device confirmation.

35.description: ^MNM: switches media tracking to black-mark sensing, then prints 1 line. Sending this also sets the app's Media selector to Black mark so auto-restore doesn't immediately revert it. UNCONFIRMED on the DPP-450: same physical memory-switch/DIP-switch caveat as set 34 - see its description.

37.description: ^MU units: dots, mm, inches - one box each (settings + draw travel in one send so auto-restore can't reset units mid-test). Unit change persists.

38.description: ~HD head diagnostics: answers into the log. No paper output.

39.description: ^HG host graphic: returns a stored graphic's data into the log. No paper output.

40.description: ^HH configuration: returns the full config listing into the log. No paper output.

41.description: ~HI host identification: printer model/firmware answers into the log. No paper output.

42.description: ~HM RAM status: memory figures answer into the log. No paper output.

43.description: ~HS host status: the 3-line status block answers into the log. No paper output.

44.description: ~HU ZebraNet alert config: answers into the log. No paper output.

45.description: ^HW file directory listing: answers into the log. No paper output.

46.description: ^HY: uploads a stored graphic back to the host, into the log. No paper output.

47.description: ^FD character-limit stress test: the same oversized payload in scalable font 0 vs bitmap font A.

48.description: Prints rounded-corner boxes at increasing corner radii.

49.description: ^HZa display description: printer XML answers into the log. No paper output.
